attack: The NZD-down camp does not own an NZ local view. FACT: on the 2026-09-18 ECB same-fixing snapshot AUDNZD is 1.2468 (5y 99.96th percentile, z 3.12, +4.27% 1m, +0.65% 1d) while AUDUSD is only +0.20% 1m (5y 84.3rd, z 1.23) and NZDUSD is -3.90% 1m (5y 8.6th, z -1.15). INFERENCE: dollar-king's claim that NZD already paid and should stay the weak cyclical treats the completed USD-tightening move as a reason to remain NZD-short through a NZ Q2 GDP beat and an India FTA, without comparing NZ inflation 51.6 and activity 52.0 to AU 49.2 and 49.2 or to the RBA housing channel (stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, prices >7% off peak). Short AUDUSD therefore shorts the non-stretching leg and leaves the 5y AUDNZD extreme untouched if both commodity currencies are offered versus a common post-FOMC/BoJ/BoE dollar bid. Perma-bear and trend-follower add no NZ evidence: receive AU 2Y and pay US 2Y can both be right without NZD remaining the funding currency versus AUD; their NZD_DOWN tags are USD/risk-off spillover. Trend-follower's 'stretch is not a reversal' rule is valid for US 2Y, where price, policy and inflation revisions align; it is not licensed on NZDUSD, which cheapened through constructive NZ news. Vol-convexity's options overlay does not refute the gap: implied vol, skew and premium are missing, and their own live-screen stand-down rule makes the put spread unexecutable from this packet. Perma-bull agrees NZD higher then refuses to own it in FX, parking the NZ impulse in US 2s10s and offering long NZDUSD — the contaminated pair — as the spot alternative. UNKNOWN: none of the NZD-down seats produce official NZ yields that would justify the cross extreme as carry.
defense: FACT: the intended discrepancy is AU versus NZ in currency space, not USD versus AUD and not US curve shape. Short AUDNZD nets out the common tightening/USD factor the desk flags after the Fed 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%, BoJ to 1.25% and hawkish BoE hold. AU housing and cooler AU inflation/activity versus NZ's hotter inflation, firmer activity, GDP beat and FTA still run against a cross that prices AU outperformance. AUDCAD is the inferior fade because a live +165bp 2Y AUD-over-CAD carry can justify that richness; AUDNZD carry cannot be measured, which is a disclosed risk rather than a measured justification of z 3.12. This is not a percentile-fade of the US 2Y type: local temperatures contradict the cross. Vol-convexity's defined-risk preference is acknowledged as instrument taste, not a packet-supported upgrade — a put spread with unquoted implied is not cleaner than spot from this freeze. INFERENCE: NZD-up here is relative to AUD, not an unconditional NZDUSD long; that is why the opposite-NZD tags fail to kill the cross. UNKNOWN and already in principal_risks: NZ labor 47.0 / unemployment 5.6%, missing NZ yields/carry, unavailable positioning, research-only ECB fixes.
holes_in_opposing_case: dollar-king tags NZD lower because NZDUSD already paid the USD premium (1m -3.90%, 5y 8.6th percentile, z -1.15) and then shorts AUDUSD, the non-stretching leg (1m +0.20%, 5y 84.3rd, z 1.23). FACT: AUDNZD is 1.2468, 99.96th percentile 5y, z 3.12, +4.27% 1m. The 1m cross rally is NZD underperformance versus a still-bid dollar, not independent AUD strength. A further common USD bid that drops AUDUSD in lockstep leaves AUDNZD rich. They never stack NZ inflation 51.6 / activity 52.0 / Q2 GDP beat / India FTA (~95% of NZ exports) against AU inflation 49.2 / activity 49.2 / housing break. NZD_DOWN is USD-factor extrapolation, not an NZ local view.

perma-bear's NZD_DOWN is a tag orphan. Primary trade is receive AU 2Y; evidence_refs skip fx:NZDUSD, NZ temperatures, NZ GDP and the FTA. A housing-broken AU front end (stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, prices >7% off peak; AU 2Y 4.999% at a 99th-percentile stretch) is AUD-negative versus NZ, not a license to dump NZD. Inferring NZD_DOWN from global risk-off/commodity beta reimports the USD factor this seat exists to net out. Their spot_candidate (short AUDUSD) repeats dollar-king's contamination.

trend-follower smuggles a valid US 2Y persistence rule onto NZD. US 2Y has aligned price, policy and inflation revisions (+57bp 1m, 100th percentile after a delivered hike). NZDUSD sold 3.90% through a GDP beat and FTA. Their spot_candidate is USDCAD, not NZD. NZD_DOWN is unanalyzed USD-higher spillover. Persistence in paying US 2Y does not imply NZD remains the funding currency versus AUD.

vol-convexity agrees the AUDNZD gap but cannot quote the put spread from this freeze: implied vol, skew, strikes and premium are UNKNOWN. Their own rule is stand down until a live screen shows the debit is not already pricing unwind versus sourced 20d realized 5.09% (AUDNZD) and 6.31% (NZDUSD). That is a reservation, not a demonstrated-superior expression. Unbounded-spot rhetoric is overstated relative to that 5.09% RV. A cash short of the same cross they identify as the discrepancy remains the only freeze-packet expression that actually owns AU versus NZ.

perma-bull's nzd_view=higher is unused. They express NZ GDP/FTA via US 2s10s and list long NZDUSD as the spot alternative. US 2s10s does not own AU versus NZ. Long NZDUSD is the USD-contaminated pair: if the curve steepens from US growth while the post-FOMC dollar bid persists, NZDUSD can still fail and AUDNZD can stay at the 5y extreme.

catalysts: Further Australian housing/financial-conditions prints confirming the RBA tightening channel.
NZ activity/inflation follow-through after the Q2 GDP beat and India FTA implementation.
Any fade in the common USD tightening bid that currently masks NZDUSD cheapness and leaves AUDNZD as the residual.
evidence_refs: rollup:Australian housing downturn deepens under higher rates
rollup:New Zealand Q2 GDP slows to 0.2% q/q but beats forecasts

expression_comparison.rationale: Dedicated spot-FX seat. The intended discrepancy is an AU-versus-NZ relative-value gap in currency space. Official NZ sovereign yields are unavailable in this packet, so AU-NZ rate RV, AUDNZD carry, and the AUDNZD~AU-NZ_2Y screen cannot be formed. Short AUDUSD or long NZDUSD would import the common USD tightening factor after the Fed hike; short AUDCAD fights a measured +165bp 2Y AUD-over-CAD carry that can justify that cross's richness. AUDNZD is the cleaner isolation.

revised_trade.invalidation: Thesis fails if AU housing and activity stabilize or rebound relative to NZ while NZ labor deterioration (unemployment already 5.6%) and missing NZ yield information resolve as a large, persistent AUD carry premium that can justify the 5y AUDNZD extreme. A 1d extension is not itself invalidation; a regime in which AUDUSD, not the cross, becomes the stretching leg would mean USD is the true driver and this expression no longer owns the gap.
revised_trade.mispricing: AUDNZD is at a 5y extreme (z 3.12) while AUDUSD is not. Pricing implies AU outperformance versus NZ that is not supported by cooler AU inflation (49.2 vs 51.6), weaker AU activity (49.2 vs 52.0), or the RBA housing channel versus NZ's GDP beat and FTA. USD expressions bury that gap inside Fed/USD beta. AUDCAD richness has a documented carry explanation; AUDNZD richness does not, because NZ yields are missing rather than because a measured NZ rate discount justifies the cross.
principal_risks: NZ labor is already the softer of the two (score 47.0; unemployment 5.6%); a labor-led NZ slowdown can keep NZD the funding/weak leg.
Official NZ yields are unavailable, so the trade may be fighting unobserved AUDNZD carry; that is a known gap, not a measured tailwind.
Positioning/flow is unavailable; a crowded short-NZD or CTA trend in AUDNZD can extend a 5y extreme.
Global energy/tightening shock can keep both commodity currencies offered, with NZD remaining the higher-beta underperformer.
No executable broker prices; ECB fixings are research/reference only.
revised_trade.thesis: FACT: ECB same-fixing AUDNZD is at 1.2468 on 2026-09-18, 99.96th percentile of the 5y window, z_5y 3.12, +4.27% over 1m and +0.65% on the day. AUDUSD is only 84.3rd percentile 5y (z 1.23, +0.20% 1m). NZDUSD is 8.6th percentile 5y (z -1.15, -3.90% 1m). Decomposition: the 1m AUDNZD rally is NZD underperformance versus a still-bid dollar, not independent AUD strength. AU temperature: inflation 49.2, labor 47.8, activity 49.2, consumer 51.0. NZ temperature: inflation 51.6, labor 47.0, activity 52.0, consumer 48.5. AU 2Y 4.999% and 10Y 5.348% sit at the 99th percentile of their 1y windows, with housing evidence that NSW stamp-duty receipts fell 24% y/y in August, transactions fell 18%, and Sydney/Melbourne values are more than 7% below peak. NZ Q2 GDP printed 0.2% q/q but beat forecasts; NZ parliament passed an India FTA covering about 95% of NZ exports. Desk thesis: energy shock and Fed/BoJ/BoE tightening are a common G10 duration/USD factor. INFERENCE: market pricing of AUDNZD as a 5y extreme requires Australia to remain the relatively stronger Pacific commodity currency, which is the opposite of the housing-versus-activity/inflation split. Expressing AU housing damage in AUDUSD shorts the dollar's post-hike bid; expressing NZ cheapness in NZDUSD does the same in reverse. Short AUDNZD owns the bilateral gap and nets out USD. AUDCAD is also 99.96th percentile 5y (z 2.76) but is co-explained by a live +165bp 2Y yield gap and only +1.95% 1m, so it is the inferior fade. UNKNOWN: NZ 2Y/5Y/10Y, AUDNZD carry, positioning/flow, and executable broker levels. NZ labor is a live offset (unemployment 5.6%).
why_now: AUDNZD printed a 5y extreme on the cutoff date (99.96th percentile, z 3.12) with a 1m move of +4.27% and a 1d extension of +0.65%, so the dislocation is live rather than stale.

Australian housing evidence from 16 Sep shows the RBA tightening channel already biting (stamp duty -24% y/y, volumes -18%, prices >7% off peak) while NZ Q2 GDP beat and an India FTA passed in the same window.
The Fed's 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00%, BoJ hike to 1.25%, and hawkish BoE hold make USD the common factor; waiting to express AU-NZ via AUDUSD or NZDUSD now maximally contaminates the view.

strongest_opposing_claim: dollar-king: NZDUSD has already paid the post-FOMC USD tightening premium (1m -3.90%, 5y 8.6th percentile), so NZD should stay/go lower as the washed cyclical and the residual USD expression is short AUDUSD (still 84th percentile, 1m only +0.20%), not a long-NZD cross.
uncertainty: Official NZ 2Y/5Y/10Y, AUDNZD carry, the AUDNZD~AU-NZ_2Y screen, positioning/flow, and executable broker levels remain unknown. Whether the 1m NZDUSD slide is flow/liquidation rather than macro cannot be tested. NZ consumer 48.5 is softer than AU consumer 51.0. Implied vol cannot be used to size continuation risk.
what_would_concede: Concede the NZD-up leg if NZ labor deterioration becomes the dominant NZ impulse (unemployment already 5.6%) and official NZ yields later show a large persistent AUD carry premium that can justify the 5y AUDNZD extreme; or if AUDUSD, not AUDNZD, becomes the stretching leg, meaning USD is the true driver and the cross no longer owns the gap; or if AU housing and activity stabilize or rebound relative to NZ.
